243:t_000:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Current position confirmed...! We're near Jupiter in the world we came from!」

243:t_000:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To think we transferred from the galactic center to the Solar System in an instant, again...」

243:t_000:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「There's a ship approaching us!」

243:t_001:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$...!」

243:t_001:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they returned to the Solar System too...」

243:t_001:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「With this many strange events in a row, I don't know if we can simply be glad...」

243:t_001:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, let's rendezvous with them and exchange information.」

243:t_001:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(The galactic center... then the transfer to a mysterious universe... then the return to the Solar System and the rendezvous with allies... It's all too convenient...)

243:t_001:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Is this... the work of someone's will...?)
